idea: Brainstorm how crews should prevent a LEAD from silently ending up with no live listener after chaining the foreground-blocking `arm` command (e.g. `arm | Out-Null; <next cmd>`). Today arm returns/arm-skips and leaves no background listener; the lead believes it is armed but is not, and only finds out via the next PreToolUse/Stop review-required gate (no silent loss, but a silent footgun). Read the arm path in plugins/crews/tools/crews.js + plugins/crews/hooks/listener-protocol.js + actor-state.js (getListenerState / isStaleArmedManifest PID-liveness). Evaluate prevention options: (a) arm detects non-interactive / redirected stdout (chained pipeline) and prints a loud warning or refuses with a non-zero exit + guidance; (b) make the arm-skipped / returned envelope impossible to swallow silently; (c) contract/doc-only change. Weigh against the legitimate standalone async arm usage (must keep working) and the arm-skipped already-active-listener path. Recommend ONE direction with a concrete, low-surface edit plan and a regression test idea. Output the brainstorm.json with recommendedDirection.
